domain_volume_over_discharge_interpretat: A bulk flushing scale, not a measured channel travel time or residence-time distribution; includes deep and slow water in the entire selected domain.
face_order: All horizontal wet/wet faces left-to-right, then vertical wet/wet faces lower-to-upper, exactly as frozen hydraulic solver. Positive stored flux travels a to z.
residual_over_volume_interpretation: Local cumulative continuity tendency at fixed volume before advective relaxation; not a prediction of temperature error. It motivates a uniform-tracer check and an explicit residual budget.
reachability_interpretation: Graph reachability includes every strictly positive stored face flux, however tiny. It proves neither meaningful week-scale renewal nor physical mixing; the evolving initial-fraction tracer remains the appropriate finite-time measure.
boundary_note: External inflow/outflow faces are absent from the NPZ. Their net water flux must be inferred from signed internal divergence at the designated stage-boundary cells and included explicitly in the tracer ledger.
